definition: D_l(z_s, N_s) = E_{z_s}(l) - E_{z_s}(l - N_s) on every state of level N_s >= 2 with z_s (0,0) quanta, D = 0 at level 0; E_z(l) = eigenvalue branch through |z> of P_l(H0 + r M + g V)P_l + D_l (self-consistent); one r(eps), g(eps) tuned at cutoff L on p = 0..3; observable E_2(L) - E_0(L). See README.md
precision_note: exact rationals: modulo 88 primes < 2^23, CRT over 80 + rational reconstruction, every value verified on 8 held-out primes; *_float = the rational rounded to double
method: Rayleigh-Schroedinger with full wavefunction corrections, degenerate partners (z >= 5) treated by the first-order-lifted degenerate RS (psi_{n-1}^B fixed by the B-projection of the order-n equation), all channels (z, l) in lock step, reflection-even J=0 sector
E_z_key: 'z,l' -> [E_z^(0)(l), ..., E_z^(k_max)(l)]; k_max = 6 (z <= 6), 4 (7 <= z <= 10), 2 (11 <= z <= 14): exactly what D needs through eps^8 (README sec. 3); the primaries (p,L), p <= 3, to order 8
channel_cap: P <= z + 4*floor(k_max/2) in channel (z,l); P <= p + 16 for the primaries (p, L)

degenerate_partners.rule: |z> is degenerate with the J=0 states of level N >= 2 and P = z - 2N (z >= 5); in channel (z,l) those with N <= l are present; lifted at first order (degeneracy.py)
